rows.label: bf01110100_0010
rows.name: So, that's how it is. I'm heading out.

rows.label: bf01110100_0020
rows.name:
I'll be back in two or three
days, so don't worry.

rows.label: bf01110100_0030
rows.name: Don't you 'that's how it is' me!

rows.label: bf01110100_0040
rows.name:
Why would you take a job
you know nothing about?

rows.label: bf01110100_0050
rows.name:
You don't even know
who your employer is!

rows.label: bf01110100_0060
rows.name:
It's a job straight from the Chairman.
It'll be fine.

rows.label: bf01110100_0070
rows.name:
Anyway, I'm off. Gramps,
just relax here and wait.
